title: Classes
body:
Syntax: help <class name>  (e.g. help ninjutsu)

Description: Your primary class, chosen at character creation, decides which jutsu you're granted automatically as you level -- see 'help <class name>' for each one's own full list. The four classes are:

&CNinjutsu&x -- elemental and utility techniques, most of them requiring hand signs. See 'help ninjutsu'.

&CGenjutsu&x -- illusion and mental techniques. See 'help genjutsu'.

&CTaijutsu&x -- pure physical combat techniques, no hand signs, no chakra cost. See 'help taijutsu'.

&CBukijutsu&x -- weapon and thrown-item techniques. See 'help bukijutsu'.

Your primary class only decides which jutsu you're automatically granted -- it doesn't restrict which weapons you can wield or which skills you can practice.

Each class also gives a real, one-time +4 boost to two attributes at character creation: Ninjutsu boosts Intelligence and Constitution, Genjutsu boosts Intelligence and Wisdom, Taijutsu boosts Strength and Dexterity, and Bukijutsu boosts Strength and Constitution.

Date: 2026-09-05
